key_people.name: Richard Gray (理查德·格雷)
key_people.title: Vice President, CTV News
key_people.title_description: Leads editorial and business operations across all CTV News platforms including CTVNews.ca, CTV News Channel, CP24, and BNN Bloomberg
key_people.description: Serving since August 2007. Oversees the full scope of CTV News operations including national and local newsrooms. Testified before parliamentary committee on media trust and disinformation in 2024 following the Poilievre video manipulation scandal.

key_people.name: Omar Sachedina (奥马尔·萨切迪纳)
key_people.title: Chief News Anchor and Senior Editor
key_people.title_description: Anchors the flagship late evening edition of CTV National News, Canada's most-watched national newscast
key_people.description: Appointed September 5, 2022, succeeding Lisa LaFlamme. Born August 21, 1982. Previously served as CTV News National Affairs Correspondent. Award-winning journalist known for international reporting and special event coverage.

key_people.name: Sandie Rinaldo (桑迪·林纳尔多)
key_people.title: Anchor, CTV National News at 5:30
key_people.title_description: Leads the early evening weekday edition of CTV National News launched November 2023
key_people.description: Veteran anchor celebrating 50+ years with CTV News since 1973. One of Canada's most recognized news personalities. Multiple Canadian Screen Award winner. Also anchors weekend editions.

key_people.name: Heather Butts (希瑟·巴茨)
key_people.title: Anchor, CTV National News Weekend
key_people.title_description: Anchors the late evening weekend edition of CTV National News
key_people.description: Toronto-based reporter and anchor. Previously hosted NewsDay on Quibi and anchored embedded weekend national news summaries for CTV O&Os.

key_people.name: Vassy Kapelos (瓦西·卡佩洛斯)
key_people.title: Chief Political Correspondent
key_people.title_description: Hosts Question Period (CTV) and Power Play (CTV News Channel), leading political coverage from the Ottawa bureau
key_people.description: Award-winning political journalist, joined CTV News December 2022 from CBC where she hosted Power and Politics. Three-time Canadian Screen Award winner. Also hosts The Vassy Kapelos Show on iHeartRadio Canada Talk Network.

key_people.name: Amanda Lang (阿曼达·朗)
key_people.title: Chief Financial Correspondent
key_people.title_description: Provides financial reporting and analysis across CTV National News, BNN Bloomberg, CTV News Channel, and CP24
key_people.description: Award-winning financial journalist. Covers Canada's economic landscape, markets, and fiscal policy across multiple CTV News platforms.

departments.name: CTV National News (CTV全国新闻)
departments.head: Omar Sachedina (奥马尔·萨切迪纳)
departments.description: Flagship nightly newscast producing early evening (5:30 ET, anchored by Sandie Rinaldo), late evening weekday (11 PM, anchored by Omar Sachedina), and late evening weekend (anchored by Heather Butts) editions. Canada's most-watched national newscast.

departments.name: CTV News Channel (CTV新闻频道)
departments.description: National 24-hour English-language cable news channel. Airs Power Play hosted by Vassy Kapelos, rolling breaking news coverage, and simulcasts of CTV National News.

departments.name: Ottawa Bureau (渥太华分社)
departments.head: Vassy Kapelos (瓦西·卡佩洛斯)
departments.description: Political bureau covering Parliament Hill and federal government. Produces Question Period (weekly political interview program) and Power Play (daily political program). Reporters include Annie Bergeron-Oliver, Judy Trinh, Jeremie Charron, Colton Praill, and Mike Le Couteur.

departments.name: Local News Operations (地方新闻业务)
departments.description: Network of 15 local newsrooms across Canada producing local newscasts at 6 PM and 11/11:30 PM. Markets include Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Ottawa, Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Halifax, and others. Noon and weekend newscasts were significantly reduced in February 2024.

departments.name: International Bureau (国际分社)
departments.description: Overseas reporting operations currently maintaining Washington D.C. bureau (Chief: Joy Malbon). Previously operated bureaus in London, Los Angeles, Moscow, and Kampala, which were closed due to cost cutting.

departments.name: CP24 (多伦多24小时新闻台)
departments.description: Regional 24-hour news channel focusing on the Greater Toronto Area and Southern Ontario. Airs regional news programs and simulcasts of CFTO Toronto's 12 noon, 6 PM and 11:30 PM newscasts.

departments.name: BNN Bloomberg (BNN彭博财经频道)
departments.description: 24-hour national business and financial news specialty channel branded under license from Bloomberg LP. Covers markets, economy, and corporate news.

departments.name: Digital News Division (数字新闻部)
departments.description: Operates CTVNews.ca (Canada's #1 digital news publisher), the CTV News App, CTV News FAST Channel, newsletters, and social media content strategy. Ranked as Canada's leading digital news publisher as of January 2026.

recent_events.title: Bell Media lays off 20 Unifor members including 11 journalists from CTV News
recent_events.description: Bell Media cut 20 Unifor union members nationwide, including 11 journalists. Among those affected were five newly unionized CTV National News members from Unifor Local 79-M in Toronto. The cuts extended to CTV Northern Ontario operations including North Bay.
recent_events.impact: Continued erosion of CTV News editorial capacity amid ongoing restructuring; raised concerns about unionization and labor relations in Canadian journalism

recent_events.title: CTV News named Canada's #1 digital news publisher for consecutive year
recent_events.description: Bell Media announced CTV News continued its position as the top digital news publisher in Canada, maintaining audience leadership across web and mobile platforms. The CTV National News late evening broadcast anchored by Omar Sachedina remained Canada's most-watched national newscast.
recent_events.impact: Confirmed CTV News's digital transformation strategy success despite significant workforce reductions

recent_events.title: BCE slashes nearly 700 jobs including 40 Bell Media positions
recent_events.description: BCE eliminated approximately 650 management positions and 40 Bell Media positions as part of a three-year strategic growth plan aimed at saving $1.5 billion. Bell CEO Mirko Bibic noted CTV's conventional stations lost over $180 million in 2023.
recent_events.impact: Highlighting the severe financial pressure on traditional broadcast news operations in Canada

recent_events.title: Bell Media eliminates 98 jobs through layoffs and buyouts
recent_events.description: Bell Media cut 98 positions, mostly in service and corporate departments. A company spokesperson stated that no CTV journalists were among those affected. The cuts were part of the ongoing restructuring following the 2024 reduction of 4,800 positions across BCE.
recent_events.impact: Further workforce reduction at parent Bell Media; cumulative impact on news organization resources

recent_events.title: CTV News fires two editors for manipulating Pierre Poilievre video clip
recent_events.description: CTV News admitted it had altered or manipulated a broadcast clip of Conservative leader Pierre Poilievre, editing his words to make it appear he said a sentence he never uttered. The network fired two news editors and apologized unreservedly. Poilievre briefly boycotted the broadcaster before ending it on October 2, 2024. VP Richard Gray later testified before a parliamentary committee on disinformation.
recent_events.impact: Major credibility crisis for CTV News; triggered parliamentary scrutiny of media ethics and public trust in Canadian journalism

recent_events.title: Bell cuts most noon and weekend CTV newscasts, cancels W5 as standalone program
recent_events.description: As part of BCE's elimination of 4,800 positions, Bell Media cancelled all noon newscasts outside Toronto, ended weekend newscasts outside Montreal, Toronto and Ottawa, and cancelled the long-running investigative newsmagazine W5 as a standalone program (brand retained for investigative features across CTV News properties). BNN Bloomberg and CTV News Channel programming were also reduced.
recent_events.impact: Dramatic scaling back of local news coverage across Canada; loss of W5 as Canada's longest-running investigative journalism program

recent_events.title: CTV adds new early evening national newscast anchored by Sandie Rinaldo
recent_events.description: CTV launched a new 30-minute early evening edition of CTV National News airing weekdays at 5:30 PM ET/PT, anchored by veteran Sandie Rinaldo. The broadcast replaced 5:30 PM local newscasts, centralizing that timeslot for national news.
recent_events.impact: Expansion of national news presence into early evening timeslot; recognized Sandie Rinaldo's 50-year career milestone

recent_events.title: Omar Sachedina named CTV National News chief anchor, replacing Lisa LaFlamme
recent_events.description: Omar Sachedina became Chief News Anchor and Senior Editor of CTV National News, replacing Lisa LaFlamme whose abrupt contract termination by Bell Media sparked national controversy over allegations of sexism and ageism. LaFlamme had been chief anchor since 2011, succeeding Lloyd Robertson after his 35-year tenure.
recent_events.impact: Major leadership transition clouded by controversy; prompted public debate about workplace ageism and sexism in Canadian media

core_business: CTV新闻（CTV News）是加拿大收视率最高的私营电视新闻机构，隶属于加拿大最大私营媒体集团贝尔传媒（Bell Media），为CTV电视网的新闻 division。CTV新闻成立于1961年，总部设于安大略省多伦多，在加拿大15个市场运营地方新闻编辑室，并通过华盛顿特区国际分社提供全球报道。其核心业务包括：一是旗舰全国新闻节目《CTV全国新闻》（CTV National News），由首席主播奥马尔·萨切迪纳（Omar Sachedina）主持晚间11点档，资深主播桑迪·林纳尔多（Sandie Rinaldo）主持下午5:30档，希瑟·巴茨（Heather Butts）主持周末档，为加拿大收视率最高的全国新闻节目；二是24小时有线新闻频道CTV News Channel，播出每日政治节目《Power Play》和滚动新闻；三是多伦多地区24小时新闻频道CP24；四是商业财经频道BNN Bloomberg（与彭博社联营品牌）；五是数字新闻平台CTVNews.ca，为加拿大排名第一的数字新闻发布商。CTV新闻还制作每周政治访谈节目《Question Period》，由首席政治记者瓦西·卡佩洛斯（Vassy Kapelos）主持。近年来，CTV新闻经历多轮裁员和重组，2024年2月取消大部分午间和周末地方新闻节目，并停播老牌调查新闻杂志节目《W5》作为独立节目。尽管如此，CTV新闻仍保持加拿大最具影响力的英语电视新闻机构地位。
apec_stance: CTV新闻作为加拿大收视率最高的全国新闻机构，在报道APEC相关议题方面发挥着重要议程设置作用。CTV新闻通过其渥太华分社和国际报道团队，持续关注加拿大与亚太经济体的贸易关系、外交互动和经济合作。2025年10月，CTV新闻对总理马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）首次以总理身份访问亚洲并进行APEC相关行程进行了全面报道，邀请前加拿大驻华大使赵朴（Guy Saint-Jacques）和亚太基金会研究员分析加拿大在亚太地区的经济利益。CTV新闻还长期跟踪加拿大与中国的关系变化，报道APEC峰会上加中领导人的互动情况。作为加拿大公共话语的重要平台，CTV新闻对APEC议题的报道框架直接影响加拿大公众对亚太经济合作和贸易多元化战略的认知。其数字平台CTVNews.ca作为加拿大排名第一的数字新闻发布商，进一步扩大了APEC相关报道的传播范围和影响力。

collection_meta.notes: Enriched profile from Wikipedia (EN), official website CTVNews.ca, Bell Media press releases, and news sources covering 2022-2026 period. Key people, departments, recent events, and APEC stance comprehensively populated.
